claim: To upgrade a Memcached cluster to a supported engine version, you use the Modify option for the cluster and specify the version in the Cache Engine Version field. The upgrade is then applied either immediately, if the Applied Immediately option is checked, or during the next scheduled maintenance window for the cluster.

evidence.quote: If you wish to initiate an upgrade to a supported engine version release, you can do so using the Modify option for your cluster. Specify the version you wish to upgrade to in the Cache Engine Version field. The upgrade will then be applied on your behalf either immediately (if the Applied Immediately option is checked) or during the next scheduled maintenance window for your cluster.
